Cost: 1,500eb (Very Expensive)
Type: Cybereye (Foundational)
Install: Clinic
Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6)
Option Slots: uses 0, provides 2

Paired Cybereyes. They install together and count as one item for Cost and Humanity Loss, but not for Critical Injuries or repair. Each eye has 2 Option Slots for Cybereye Options, and each comes with Color Shift and Image Enhance pre-installed, which cost no Humanity Loss and take no Option Slots. Those two can't be removed without destroying the eyes beyond repair. On a Perception check to visually spot small or hidden objects (mines, traps, turrets, hidden buttons), the user gets another +1.

Foundry notes:

  • One item for the pair, as Corgo prices and installs them together. It carries 2 Option Slots, the count for one eye; add a second copy or raise the slots by hand if your table tracks each eye separately.
  • The pre-installed Color Shift and Image Enhance are described here rather than installed as separate items; install them from the core compendium if you want them on the sheet.
  • The +1 is situational because it only covers small or hidden objects: tick it in the roll dialog.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Cyberoptics).
